prompt: Can you add one minute to the time of the title track from the album released by Ray Charles in the year before Phil Quartararo took over as president of its record label?
answer: Phil Quartararo took over as president of Warner Bros. Records in 1994, so the relevant Ray Charles album is **_My World_** (1993). Its title track runs about **4:12**; adding one minute gives **5:12**.
